No statement should be read to concede the relevance, admissibility, or discoverability of any material.
edits.name: Preliminary statement

edits.text: 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks information protected from disclosure by the attorney-client privilege, work-product protection, or any other applicable protection. Defendant also objects to each request to the extent it is vague, ambiguous, overbroad, unduly burdensome, or seeks material not relevant to the claims or defenses or not proportional to the needs of the case. These general objections apply only to the extent stated in a specific response and do not replace any request-specific objection. Defendant does not waive any applicable objection or protection.
edits.name: General objections

edits.text: 2. PRODUCTION. Subject to and without waiving any stated objection, Defendant will produce non-privileged responsive documents in its possession, custody, or control, if any, in accordance with the applicable rules and a mutually agreed production schedule. Any limitation on the scope of a response will be stated in the response to the particular request. The parties may meet and confer regarding search scope, form of production, and timing.
edits.name: Production

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. To the extent required by the applicable rules, Defendant will provide information sufficient to assess any claim of privilege or protection for responsive material withheld on that basis, subject to any agreement or court order concerning the form or timing of a log. Defendant will not disclose privileged or protected substance in doing so.
edits.name: Privilege log

edits.text: 4. SUPPLEMENTATION. Defendant will supplement or correct these responses as required by the applicable rules. Nothing in this response limits any party’s rights or obligations under those rules.
edits.name: Supplementation
